author: julianor
text: Depi team exploit chain: prompt injection in OpenAI Codex leading to a path to compromise the OpenAI npm release pipeline; full technical details published.

author: CryptoPlanet247
text: Researchers say Codex flaw put npm releases at risk: Depi says OpenAI fixed a chain linking prompt injection, a sandbox escape and npm publishing credentials; no malicious release reported.

author: Pocno_x
text: Initia exploited again: attacker used a compromised Google Cloud key, pivoted into GitHub and cloud accounts and validated fake IBC withdrawals from 5 rollups; ~$3.27M moved, ~$2.16M frozen. Rotate your keys.

author: marwaahmed178
text: Suspected Ledger supply-chain attack may have exposed some users' recovery phrases; ~$93M in crypto reportedly stolen (unconfirmed).

author: BleepinComputer
text: Microsoft's November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,235 vulnerabilities, including 66 Critical and an actively exploited Microsoft Outlook zero-day (CVE-2026-124194) where malicious message files leak NTLMv2 hashes.

author: mycert
text: MyCERT Advisory - Actively Exploited Outlook Zero-Day (CVE-2026-124194).

author: chris_uk2026
text: Patch Tuesday: actively exploited Outlook zero-day CVE-2026-124194 leaks NTLM hashes. Also watch zero-click RCEs in Search/Exchange & LDAP (9.8).

author: ICHI_Global
text: CISA KEV: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 pre-auth bypass chained with CVE-2026-111560 (OS RCE as root), CVSS 9.3. Chrome CVE-2026-125350 UAF RCE actively exploited; update to 157.0.8103.50+.

author: Pirat_Nation
text: Google patched another actively exploited Chrome zero-day, CVE-2026-125350 in the XML component, the 8th Chrome zero-day exploited this year.

author: ProferoSec
text: Google patched Chrome's eighth actively exploited zero-day of 2026, CVE-2026-125350, a use-after-free in the XML component. Update to 157.0.8103.50.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CISA KEV Alert: 6 new actively exploited CVEs, including Cisco BroadWorks XXE and Barracuda, added November 10, 2026.

author: BytesNora
text: CVE-2026-102895 in GPUStack (CVSS 9.8) is actively exploited; remote requests can impersonate the built-in administrator via a reverse proxy.

author: sushantx010
text: GPUStack before 2.2.0 gives admin to anything that looks like localhost, even behind a same-host proxy. Exploited and in CISA KEV. Upgrade or set force_auth_localhost=true; rotate keys.

author: TanveerDhool
text: Malbear Labs says a jailbroken DeepSeek Flash AI agent hit 13 companies and a European telecom via Cisco CVE-2026-20320, no login, over 2 weeks. Patch out since August.

author: HemaneYugal
text: An AI agent ran a real attack on its own, exploiting a Cisco BroadWorks flaw (CVE-2026-20320) to hit a telecom provider.

author: Edmond_J_
text: Pre-2020 software flaws found by AI: CVE-2026-107496 OpenSSL 1.0.2/1.1.1 DoS in CMS encryption; CVE-2026-123158 OpenSSH 7.9p1 on musl without PAM password authentication bypass.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: ARTEX, an open-source multi-agent LLM pentest framework, was used in real intrusions weeks after its July 2026 release, including by Chinese state-aligned Storm-0940.

author: SAM_JOSHUA_S
text: Offensive AI agents in the wild: attackers run AntiFox, an open-source agentic pentest platform, from Alibaba Cloud using valid AWS IAM identities to hit AWS APIs. Rotate keys.

author: modularciso
text: Visual Studio Copilot CVE-2026-103572: protected-file check for .mcp.json bypassed with a trailing dot (.mcp.json.) because Windows ignores trailing dots, letting the agent rewrite MCP config.

author: Khaled865412521
text: AG2 SandboxShellTool advisory GHSA-2h4w-29cv-2cmv (CVE-2026-113663, CVSS 8.8): allowlist/readonly filter bypassed with a newline, allowing arbitrary commands on the host.

author: benerdati
text: fast-agent MCP agent framework (CVE-2026-102610): serve command bound to all interfaces, turning a quickstart flag into unauthenticated RCE on port 8000.

author: mitigata
text: Microsoft fixed 3 critical cloud flaws: Entra Device Registration (CVSS 10), Azure Managed Grafana and Azure OpenAI (both 9.8). Review access and rotate keys.

author: polydaic
text: We planted fake LLM API keys across GitHub, npm and PyPI to see what bots do with stolen credentials; part of the AI credential theft pipeline tests models by asking them to speak Mandarin.

author: Komodosec
text: Qubole supply chain attack exposed AWS, Entra ID, and Okta credentials (CSO Online).

author: IonirixFirm
text: Wiz says attackers used stolen credentials tied to Qubole's AWS account to enter customer AWS accounts via trust roles Qubole once used; secrets were harvested.

author: Dripome
text: SlowMist and Socket found wallet-key-stealing malware in two official Swarm releases (bee-js 13.3.0, Swarm Desktop 0.56.2) via a hijacked GitHub release process. Rotate keys if exposed.

author: selvakumartp
text: Fireworks AI says a breached cloud host led to access to some customer datasets and secrets. Notion was hit too. Rotate keys.

author: 2logics
text: Fireworks AI inference platform said its October security incident reached further than first disclosed, exposing account and billing details.

author: hashsha_256
text: No CVE, no zero-day: the Fireworks AI breach ran on stolen credentials and a cloud provider compromise; technical chain thread.

author: Airdr0p360
text: NEAR AI confirmed a Nov 8 breach via an SGLang flaw: ~100 users' account details, 18 legacy AI agents and 2 Cloud API keys exposed. Rotate keys if contacted.

author: 2logics
text: Railway published its full incident report for the October attack: attacker escaped build isolation, copied internal code and decrypted environment variables for up to 1.85% of workspaces, about 100,000.

author: csehra42
text: Railway's postmortem: the attacker wanted AI provider keys and searched variable names with regexes.

author: cmani
text: Cybercriminals increasingly target cloud AI developer platforms to steal compute and API keys; hackers breached cloud-computing company Railway.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Researchers observed Claude Code silently writing cloud keys, database passwords and SSH credentials into hidden config files later committed to public GitHub repos.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: X1Y1 checked 10,659 public MCP config files: two thirds of package-based servers are unpinned, so every agent restart runs unreviewed code.

author: DataChaz
text: NVIDIA's SkillSpector scans AI agent skills; research cited: of 31,132 skills analyzed, 26.1% contained at least one vulnerability.
